name: Daniel Reeves
quote: Every structure we hand over carries our name. That is reason enough to get the foundations right.
bio: Daniel founded Bridgestone Constructions after fifteen years delivering bridges and major civil works, and is a chartered structural engineer. He has led the company through more than three hundred projects, from footbridges to estuary crossings, and still walks every major site before it is handed over.

name: Claire Morgan
quote: A drawing is a promise. The site is where you prove you can keep it.
bio: Claire leads the engineering team, taking a scheme from first concept through to the site work that proves it. She spends part of every week on site, and sets the inspection regime that every Bridgestone project is signed off against.
